title: Family Emergency Action Plan
description: Walks through seven steps: identifying risks, setting communication protocols, choosing three meeting points, assigning family roles, planning for fire, shelter-in-place, evacuation, and separation, documenting, and drilling. Ends with a fill-in plan template and a quick reference card.
shortDescription: Seven steps to a written all-hazards plan, with a fill-in template
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
